question_pt: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior crescimento absoluto de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023, considerando diagnósticos com mais de 1000 internações no primeiro período?
ground_truth_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p2.n2 - p1.n1) AS crescimento_absoluto FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY crescimento_absoluto DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH periodo_1 AS ( SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND i."DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i."DIAG_PRINC"), periodo_2 AS ( SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND i."DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i."DIAG_PRINC") SELECT COALESCE(c."DESCRICAO", p1.cid) AS diagnostico, p1.total_internacoes AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.total_internacoes AS periodo_2019_2023, p2.total_internacoes - p1.total_internacoes AS crescimento_absoluto FROM periodo_1 p1 JOIN periodo_2 p2 ON p1.cid = p2.cid LEFT JOIN cid c ON p1.cid = c."CID" WHERE p2.total_internacoes > p1.total_internacoes AND p1.total_internacoes > 1000 ORDER BY crescimento_absoluto DESC LIMIT 10;
